subject: Procurement portal credential sync + Term amendment for HelioWorks renewal
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@helioworks.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioworks.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal scope & procurement portal access (capacity bump)

Hi Rishi,

We're getting close to our renewal for the Redwood contract and want to make sure procurement has everything to process an amended term. A couple of items from our side: 

- We're planning to increase committed capacity by ~35% starting July 1 — need an SOW or amendment that shows the new committed units and updated pricing.
- Our procurement team needs portal access (vendor onboarding) so they can submit a PO and complete their internal checks. They usually require proof of SOC2, signed T&Cs, and a contact in your billing ops.

Can you send the updated SOW/draft amendment and invite procurement (procurement@helioworks.com) to your procurement portal? If there are any lead-time items for onboarding (credentials, vendor forms), please list them so we can triage.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Head of Platform Partnerships
HelioWorks

Attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@helioworks.com>, procurement@helioworks.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & procurement portal access (capacity bump)

Sophie — thanks for the notes. Quick summary and next steps from our side: 

1) I attached a draft SOW (HelioWorks_SOW_v2.pdf) and a term amendment template (redwood_term_amendment_draft.docx) that reflect the +35% committed capacity and prorated billing starting 2027-07-01. Please review and flag any line items that need adjustment.

2) Procurement portal access: procurement@helioworks.com is now invited to our procurement portal — you should receive an invite email from no-reply@redwood.com; the onboarding flow includes: vendor profile, W-9 (US), SOC2 attestation link, and contact for billing ops. I also attached a short checklist for portal completion (Procurement-Portal-Checklist.xlsx).

3) For SOC2 and T&C: marissa_cole from contracts is cc'd and will attach the SOC2 summary and the proposed contract redlines. If procurement needs a PDF bundle for their vendor system, we can generate that today.

If procurement confirms PO timing I can route the amendment to DocuSign and loop in Alex Mercer at ContractHub for e-sign handling. Propose a brief alignment call tomorrow at 10:00am PT — Sophie, does that work?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: HelioWorks_SOW_v2.pdf; redwood_term_amendment_draft.docx; Procurement-Portal-Checklist.xlsx
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@helioworks.com>, procurement@helioworks.com, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal scope & procurement portal access (capacity bump)

Hi all — adding the legal/contract touchpoints.

I've reviewed the SOW draft Rishi attached. High-level redline notes I want to call out before we send to DocuSign: 

- Term: amendment should clearly state new committed units and the effective date (2027-07-01); keep original anniversary as-is.
- Billing proration: confirm whether HelioWorks prefers one-time prorated invoice or spread across next two billing cycles (I recommend single prorated invoice).
- Data controls: add explicit reference to VPC/private deployment options in section 4.
- Liability cap: no changes unless requested by HelioWorks — will keep as status quo.

@laura_bennett — can you confirm if we have any current discount approval that needs leadership sign-off for this +35% capacity?

I'll prepare the redline PDF and upload to the procurement portal bundle once I have confirmation on proration preference.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
